Terms of service

Last updated: 6 August 2026

Template notice for the site owner: have a lawyer review and adapt this before launch, and check that every clause matches how you actually work. Then delete this box.

These terms govern the services provided by Disha Consultancy Services ("we", "us") to you ("the client"). By booking a session, paying a fee or using this website, you accept them.

1. What we provide

We provide information, guidance and counselling services relating to education, admissions, careers and personal direction. Our services are advisory in nature. We do not provide legal, medical, psychiatric, clinical psychological, financial-investment or immigration advice.

2. What we do not promise

  • We do not guarantee admission to any institution, allotment of any seat, any rank, any scholarship, any visa, any job, or any level of earnings.
  • We are not agents of, affiliated with, or authorised to represent any examination body, counselling authority, university, college, coaching institute or employer.
  • We cannot influence any selection, allotment or hiring decision, and we will never claim to.
  • Any figures, cutoffs, fees or timelines we discuss are indicative and drawn from published sources; official notifications always prevail.

3. Your responsibilities

  • Give us accurate and complete information. Advice based on inaccurate inputs will be wrong, and that is not a service failure.
  • Verify every date, eligibility rule and fee against the official source before you act.
  • Submit your own applications and operate your own logins. We will never ask for your password or OTP, and you must not share them with us or anyone else.
  • Make your own final decisions. Our role is to inform them, not to make them for you.

4. Bookings, fees and payment

  • The discovery call is free and carries no obligation.
  • Paid sessions are scheduled after the fee is received. Fees are as published on our pricing page or in your written quote.
  • Fees are exclusive of applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. A valid invoice is issued for every payment.
  • Payments must be made only to our official business account or payment link. We are not responsible for money sent to any other account.
  • Third-party costs — examination, application, counselling registration, assessment platform or institutional fees — are paid by you, directly to those bodies.

5. Rescheduling and cancellation

Governed by our refund and cancellation policy, which forms part of these terms.

6. Confidentiality

We keep your information confidential and use it only as described in our privacy policy. We may disclose information where the law requires it, or where there is a serious and immediate risk to someone's safety. Where the client is a minor, information is shared with the parent or guardian who engaged us, other than material the student shares in confidence that does not bear on their safety.

7. Intellectual property

Reports, roadmaps, templates and other materials we prepare are provided for your personal use. You may not resell, publish or distribute them commercially. Website content is our property and may not be reproduced without written permission.

8. Recording of sessions

Neither party may record a session without the other's prior consent. Where a mock interview is recorded for your feedback, the recording is shared with you and deleted from our systems afterwards.

9. Acceptable use

Abusive, threatening or discriminatory behaviour towards our counsellors ends the engagement immediately, with no refund for sessions already delivered. We reserve the right to decline or discontinue any engagement, refunding fees for undelivered services.

10. Limitation of liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, our total liability arising out of or in connection with our services is limited to the fees you have actually paid us for the service in question. We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, including loss of admission, loss of employment, loss of earnings or loss of opportunity.

Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, including under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

11. Third-party links

This website links to official portals and other third-party sites for your convenience. We do not control them and are not responsible for their content, accuracy or availability.

12. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh have exclusive jurisdiction, subject to any consumer rights you have to bring proceedings elsewhere.
